items.text: `beacon design truth --write` keeps writing only version-wide design surfaces by default.
`beacon design truth --write --include-project-truth` creates missing `PRODUCT.md`.
`beacon design truth --write --include-project-truth` creates missing `DESIGN.md`.
Existing `PRODUCT.md` and `DESIGN.md` are reported as `exists` and are not overwritten without `--force`.
With `--force`, existing project-level truth files may be overwritten and reported as `overwritten`.
JSON output reports per-path write status.
Generated `PRODUCT.md` identifies itself as project-level product truth and includes required starter sections.
Generated `DESIGN.md` identifies itself as project-level design truth and includes required starter sections.
`.machine/design/design-contract.projection.json` remains projection-only.
Design support outputs still require Beacon truth binding before implementation.
